routes.name: Visa on arrival
routes.summary: Citizens of all countries can get a visa on arrival without prior application. Fees are capped at 50 USD single entry and 70 USD multiple entry. Many groups enter free.

other: African Union, Commonwealth and La Francophonie members: free, 30 days.
East African Community members: free pass, 6 months.

Free 90 days: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, Cote d'Ivoire, DR Congo, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Ghana, Guinea, Indonesia, Haiti, Mauritius, Philippines, Senegal, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Sao Tome and Principe, Singapore, Qatar.
Others may apply online beforehand.

routes.name: Visitor visas (V1 holiday, V5 conference, V6 business survey and others)
routes.summary: Visitor visas are online, at the border or at a mission. Holiday V1 is 50 USD for 30 days or 70 USD for 90 days multiple entry. Conference V5 is 50 USD, 30 days. Business survey V6 is 50 or 70 USD, 90 days.

other: Work is not allowed on visitor visas.
Visa waiver (VE-1) is free: 90 days for waiver countries, 30 days for AU, Commonwealth and Francophonie members.

stay.note: V1 single entry is 30 days, multiple entry 90 days. V6 renewable once.

routes.name: Transit visa (VT)
routes.summary: Transit visa on arrival for up to 3 days, 30 USD. Transit visa holders are not allowed to work.

other: Airside transit rules not confirmed.

routes.name: Job search visa (V4)
routes.summary: For skilled workers looking for jobs in occupations on the demand list. 50 USD, 90 days, multiple entries, renewable.

eligibility.education: Skilled worker in an occupation on the demand list

routes.name: Temporary residence permit (employed or self-employed)
routes.summary: Employed and self-employed foreigners get a 2 year renewable permit. Holders with two prior permits in the same category can get 5 years. Apply within 15 working days of entry or contract. Holders may live with family and work.

other: Employment contract or registered business.
Intra-company transfer (Q1) needs proof of affiliation, contract, criminal record certificate and a host recommendation letter.
Business investor, entrepreneur, employment and study categories exist on the immigration site, but their pages had no details.

stay.note: Up to 3 years for foreigners of particular national interest.

routes.processing: Permits are generally issued within 10 days, per the ministerial order.

routes.name: Permit K (assured income, retirees)
routes.summary: For people with assured income, including retirees not seeking work. 150,000 RWF, up to 2 years. Needs a retirement certificate, Rwandan bank statement and local medical insurance.

other: Retirement certificate.
Rwandan bank statement.
Local medical insurance.
Police clearance from country of residence covering the previous 6 months.
Income amount not stated.

routes.name: Other permits (volunteer, special pass, cross-border worker, clergy, NGO founder)
routes.summary: Smaller permits: P1 volunteer 50,000 RWF up to 1 year, R special pass 50,000 RWF 3 months, S1 and S2 cross-border workers up to 2 years, I clergy 150,000 RWF, N1 international NGO founder 150,000 RWF, Q2 regular trips 250,000 RWF.

other: Each permit has its own document list on the official page.

routes.name: Permanent residence permit (L)
routes.summary: L-1 needs 10 years of legal residence. Other classes: L-2 exceptional contribution, L-3 senior multinational staff, L-4 Rwandans abroad, L-5 spouse of a holder, L-6 child of a holder aged 25+, L-7 humanitarian. It can be canceled after 3 consecutive years abroad.

other: L-1: 10 years legal residence in total.

routes.name: Citizenship by residence
routes.summary: Needs 15 years of legal, physical residence plus good conduct. Fee 10,000 RWF, processing about 6 months. Immigrants need 25 years or descent from a migrant.

other: 15 consecutive years of physical residence shown by residence permits.
Good conduct, no sentence of 6 months or more.
Detailed CV, birth record, passport and photo.

citizenship.note: Dual citizenship rule not stated on the official pages read.

routes.name: Citizenship by marriage
routes.summary: Needs a marriage of at least 5 years to a Rwandan, three Rwandan witnesses, an interview with the spouse and a shared-life certificate. Fee 5,000 RWF.

other: Married at least 5 years.
Three Rwandan witnesses.
Certificate of shared marital life.

routes.name: Citizenship for sustainable investment, special skills or national interest
routes.summary: Other acquisition routes: substantial sustainable investment (investor registration plus district certificate), special skills or talent, national interest. No investment amount is stated.

other: Investment: proof of investor registration and a certificate of sustainable activity from district authorities.
Special skills: commitment letter and recommendation from the organization seeking the skills.

routes.name: East African Community visitor pass
routes.summary: Citizens of EAC partner states get a free visitor's pass at the border, up to 6 months, single entry.
